notes.note: Traced retained activation cleanup from the accepted turn and canonical terminal through interruption and confirmed park. The existing adapter cleanup budget bounds the wait for an interrupt reply. Only the exact activation owner can retire its engine and only confirmed exit releases it. Expired caller authority no longer discards an already-observed internal receipt after confirmed cleanup. The dormant owner supplies no public delivery or replay authority. Ordinary requests, stop flows and request-inspection captures keep their original scopes.
